title: The Golden Crown
description: A crowned skeletal figure in dark royal robes and a gas mask sits at a table, writing with a quill while golden rings float around its head and drip from its crown. In the background, a group of robed figures kneel before a black altar with lit candles and scattered golden rings under dramatic glowing orbs.
